variable.name: Soil Temperature · GLDAS (0–10 cm)
variable.desc: Monthly upper-soil temperature from the GLDAS Noah model

provenance.access: Monthly point-series API for every intersecting GLDAS source cell
provenance.aggregation: Native-cell polygon overlap × cos(latitude); at least 80% selected area each month
provenance.quality: GLDAS model estimates; provider fill excluded. Soil water mass is not a saturation fraction; wind is near-surface forcing, not a verified 2 m measurement.

provenance.access: Giovanni area averaging through NASA Harmony; regional CSV only
provenance.aggregation: NASA server rectangle average; monthly spatial support is not supplied
provenance.quality: Monthly mean instantaneous assimilation diagnostics; a different product from native mode. Cell weighting follows NASA's service.
